about: The pre-flight streaming line for a set of platforms (preflightSummary in packages/protocol, preflight_summary in the Rust daemon). Both must give exactly these. Add cases; change wording only on purpose, in both places.

cases.name: nothing set up
cases.expect: No streaming platforms are set up.

cases.name: one paused
cases.expect: YouTube 360p. Facebook won't fit and would be paused.

cases.name: two paused, no name falls back to the id
cases.expect: YouTube 360p. fb, Vimeo won't fit and would be paused.

cases.name: nothing fits
cases.expect: YouTube won't fit and would be paused.
